title: F2 Counter Output at Each Step
statement: For every Boolean list $x$, every valid input-head position $p$ for $x$, and every Boolean list $bs$, at each natural time $i \le |bs|$, the counter machine run for $i$ steps from state $3$, input-head position $p$, work-tape head position $0$, tape containing $bs$, and empty output is in state $3$, with the same input-head and work-tape head positions and tape, and with output equal to the first $i$ entries of $bs$.
